info.title: The Sacred Blacksmith
info.synopsis: C'era una volta' una tragica guerra, in cui il potere dei demoni era stato rilasciato portando caos e distruzione tra i popoli. Dopo la guerra, il potere dei demoni venne bandito e nel mondo sembrò essere tornata la pace. Cecily Campbell è un cavaliere alla ricerca di un fabbro per riparare la sua vecchia spada lasciatagli da suo padre. Un giorno Cecil assiste allo scontro tra un uomo in lotta con un furfante che sembra abusare del potere proibito del diavolo. L'uomo lo sconfigge con un solo colpo vibrato con una spada molto strana. Il misterioso individuo si scoprirà  essere un fabbro di nome Luke. L'incontro fatale segnerà  l'inizio di una grande avventura'

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Cecily Campbell is the head of the Campbell house and a member of the 'Knight Guards' responsible for protecting the Independent Trade City of Housman. When Cecily's sword is broken in a confrontation with a former knight she must search for a blacksmith to repair it. Unfortunately the only person skilled enough is Luke Ainsworth, who also happens to be the one who saved her life during the earlier fight. However, before he can even start his task Luke must once again save Cecily's life when a local trade caravan is attacked by monsters.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Following the revelation that Lisa is a demon, Cecily begins to avoid both her and Luke. However, she soon realises how foolishly she has been acting when she is invited to attend a conference concerning Valbanil and the Sacred Sword, which Luke and Siegfried also attend. Unfortunately, the revelations at the conference only serve to fuel Siegfried's anger and he decides it is time to put his plans into motion.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: After his humiliation during the conference Siegfried finally snaps and dispatches a horde of demons to destroy the City of Housman. While Cecily and Aria join the Knight Guards in dealing with the demons, Luke decides it is time to settle things with Siegfried. However, even Luke may not be strong enough to stand against Siegfried's Demon Sword of Darkness, at least not without help.
